title: Wilma J NDE 3959
content: It was the most wonderful thing I ever been through. After I gave birth to my second child I had a bad reaction to a medication I was given. I remember having trouble breathing and I knew I was dying and for some odd reason I was not afraid. I closed my eyes and went with it. Next thing I remember was complete darkness and feeling very confused. Then I realized I was in a tunnel and did not know how to get out. I started to feel scared. It was then that I saw a glow of light and a hand reaches out to me. I grabbed the hand and was pulled to the other side where I was greeted with the most handsome spirit who guided me through this experience. I was told it was not my time but that God wanted me to know to start taking my life more seriously or I would be dead soon. I was told I have to come back and take care of my kids. I was told to be more understanding toward my mother. I also was told he would always be there for me. I cried because I did not want to come back here because I felt so much peace and calmness and love that I never felt before. It was really beautiful and dying to me is something I do not fear anymore or feel negative towards. I feel closer to my God and I share my experience with people who are chronically ill in order to help them not fear death. And it's a funny thing that now I have a kidney disease. It's going on nine years since I have been on dialysis and I do not fear dying and I can pass my knowledge of the afterlife to others who need to know it's okay.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "hand" reached out from a glow of light; on the other side she was greeted by "the most handsome spirit" who guided her.

environment.environment_other_detail: She reported "complete darkness" before realizing she was in a tunnel, then a "glow of light" and being "pulled to the other side."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was told it was not her time; she "ha[s] to come back and take care of my kids," to "start taking my life more seriously" or she would "be dead soon," and to "be more understanding toward my mother."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bad reaction to medication given after giving birth; trouble breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/confusion; a hand reached out; greeted by a spirit guide; message from God about returning and life changes.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/confusion preceded awareness of being in a tunnel; then light/hand, arrival on the other side, guidance, then instructed to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A "hand" reached out from the glow of light, which she grabbed and was pulled through the tunnel to the other side.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Next thing I remember was complete darkness and feeling very confused." "Then I realized I was in a tunnel and did not know how to get out." "I saw a glow of light and a hand reaches out to me." "I cried because I did not want to come back here because I felt so much peace and calmness and love that I never felt before."
